usedFor: Jumpseller runs the store and Google Docs holds a running note via “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product Added” in Jumpseller, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new product adds a line to a catalog tab, so the team sees launches in one place.

watchOut: The replace option in “Add or Replace Text In Tab” wipes the tab's current content, so pick adding before connecting.
